text:
incidents-bot: SEV2 alert — spike in 5xx and timeout rates for /v1/generate in us-west-2 (started ~1928503300). Error breakdown: 502 gateway, 504 timeout, and internal 5xx from scheduler. Paging sara (oncall).
sara (oncall): I’m on it. seeing dashboards — tail latency up, p50 ok but p95+p99 blown out. customers reporting streaming stalls.
jae (eng-runtime): grabbing traces. preliminary looks like batching/scheduler queue depth increasing ~x10, head-of-line blocking on a few long-running batches. suspect recent batch-sizing heuristic landed in prod last deploy.
marcus (sre): Confirmed. Prometheus: scheduler_queue_length spikes to 1200, avg batch latency 4s -> 25s. Gateway 504s correlate with queue drain timeouts. Attached sample from lb logs: `upstream_error: timeout after 15s`
olga (support): I’ve got a thread from a small SaaS customer reporting repeated 504s, they’re seeing timeouts in their UX. Raised maybe 3 tickets in the last 10m.
sara (oncall): Priority actions: 1) Quietly rollback batch heuristic? 2) Open emergency route to fallback model/legacy endpoint 3) Scale dedicated pool for us-west-2 if safe. Jae/Kai you pick one.
kai (eng-platform): We can toggle emergency routing to fallback model variant (lower perf but stable) with a 2-line config change. I’ll stage the route if you give me approval.
jae (eng-runtime): I’m going to revert the batch-sizing change — pushing a canary rollback to us-west-2 now. Deploy-bot can you confirm the change id: `bsize-opt-2026-11`?
deploy-bot: Rollback initiated for `bsize-opt-2026-11` in us-west-2. Canary -> 10% traffic, 0.5m rollout with health checks.
marcus (sre): While rollback runs, we should also evict stuck batches older than 20s to free queue head. I have a script: 
```
# evict long running batches
curl -X POST "https://platform-api.internal/scheduler/evict" -d '{"older_than_ms":20000}' -H "Authorization: Bearer $SCHED_TOKEN"
```
I’ll run after rollback stabilizes for a minute.
olga (support): FYI pushing a banner to affected customers — workaround: retry on 5xx with exponential backoff 200ms->1600ms. Sharing context with top 10 accounts.
sara (oncall): Deploy-bot reports canary healthy for 8m, error rate down 35% but still elevated. Proceed with full rollback? Jae confirm.
jae (eng-runtime): Proceeding to full rollback to remove the heuristic. Also increasing scheduler worker count by +2 on hot hosts — will attempt graceful scale.
kai (eng-platform): Emergency route enabled: 20% of new requests route to model-variant-stable in us-west-2. This should cut latency for a subset of requests immediately.
marcus (sre): After eviction and scaling, queue_length dropped to ~200, p99 started to fall. Gateway 504s are decreasing but we still see bursts. Running a short-lived traffic shaping to limit per-client concurrency.
olga (support): Notifying customers: banner updated + top customers messaged. Asking for any customer-visible regressions after rollback.
ton y (product): (typo corrected) tony (product): keep me posted on broad impact; we need an incident summary for the execs if this stays >10m.
sara (oncall): Quick impact calc: ~2.3% of total requests in us-west-2 saw 5xx/timeouts over the last 20m, higher for high-concurrency customers. No data exfil confirmed.
jae (eng-runtime): Root cause hypothesis: new batch-sizing heuristic underestimated variance for long sequences; a subset of long-running requests monopolized the batch queue causing head-of-line blocking. Fix: rollback + add per-queue age eviction + backpressure threshold.
marcus (sre): Mitigations applied: rollback completed at 1928503480, eviction script run at 1928503505, scale +2 at 1928503520, emergency route at 1928503530. Error rate dropped to baseline by 1928503585.
incidents-bot: Incident timeline recorded. Paging escalation to postmortem channel scheduled in 1h; runbook link: https://internal.redwood/ops/runbooks/scheduler-congestion
olga (support): Customers with enterprise SLAs: two reached out; both acknowledged temporary degradation, one asked for credit. Logged CSAT impact.
sara (oncall): Handing off to jae for follow-up and a postmortem. Please include the exact code change id, perf graphs, and a repro (if possible). Marcus, can you lead rollback verification and guardrails work?
marcus (sre): I’ll own guardrails: implement per-batch max-age + circuit-breaker at 500ms queue-ramp for new heuristics, and a synthetic load test to catch regressions.
jae (eng-runtime): I’ll add a canary test that simulates long sequences and runs in CI before merge; will also open a PR to add telemetry for batch composition.
ton y (product): Need a short customer-facing note after postmortem. I’ll draft with Olga.
sara (oncall): Closing live mitigation. If anyone sees a regression or new 5xx spike, re-open this thread. Great coordination — :thumbsup:
incidents-bot: Incident closed for live mitigation at 1928503600. Postmortem assignment: jae, marcus, olga.
